purpose: Post-feasibility development selection gate that implements the pre-existing stock-stage design priorities before any held-out qualification.
non_claims: These are development selection gates, not F qualification thresholds.
The 20-reference and 10-ambiguous floors are engineering identifiability floors introduced after the feasibility pilot exposed sparse stage-3 and ambiguity evidence.
The 0.60 coverage, 0.10 ambiguity, 0.80 precision-lower-bound and 0.03 noninferiority values implement priorities already documented before the first R1 result.
Passing this policy does not authorize SHADOW, QUALIFIED, 2022-2025 access, strategy use, or trading.
